snippet.title: Granny 2 Reworked (Testing) (Old) #3 | New weapon ELPG, Slenderina baby
snippet.description:
#granny #dvloper #grannygame  #GrannyCHTwoReworked #granny3 #grannyallchapters #grannynewgame #grannynewupdate #slendrinahorrorgame #grannyandslendrina #slendrina #horrorgame  #grannyvsgrannychaptertwo #grannygame #granny My developer channel: @REdernGames https://youtube.com/@ReDernGames?si=esJv2RIrzjs3kPMR

Note:
The reworked version was created from scratch

In one of several videos in which I make and test my reworked version of Granny 2. Description of me and so on: I am a novice game developer, I have already had projects that did not come out if you want to look at them write in the comments, I want Granny 2 reworked to come out at the time of writing the description, the game can be said to be ready, all that remains is to fix bugs a little and somehow manage to cope with assembling the project into an exe file. In the version that will be released, you will see something new from me: New location, character, puzzles and I will give one hint at a new character: Slendrina cellar level two remember who was running after you along the dark long corridor? I think that you probably understood who it was! If I can’t compile the project in any way, I will release a video in the description of which there will be a link to all the Granny 2 Reworked files.
